articles.title: A New Earth-Like Planet? Meet GJ 3378b, Our Cosmic Neighbor!
articles.summary: Imagine a world just 25 light-years away that might have oceans and life! Scientists found a rocky planet, GJ 3378b, orbiting a red dwarf star. It's in the habitable zone, but we don't know if it has an atmosphere yet.

articles.title: Oops! A Lab Mistake Might Make Computers Think Like Brains!
articles.summary: A student forgot to connect a wire in a transistor, and it started acting like a brain cell! This happy accident could lead to computer chips that use way less energy — like your brain does. It's a big step toward smarter, greener AI.

articles.title: Sea Anemones Have a Totally Weird Way to Fight Viruses!
articles.summary: Scientists found that sea anemones use a protein called CARDIB to fight viruses — but it works backwards! Instead of turning on the immune system, it puts the brakes on. And that brake is exactly what helps them survive infections.
